answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
